probe_result: Bounded symbolic restart probe across three serialized transitions and eight slot-reuse cases. Both numeric-generation and unique predecessor-epoch binding repaired a one-copy current intent despite a stale n-2 record and failed closed on conflicting current intents, missing current intent, and successor-integrity mismatches. When a numeric generation value was reused, generation-only binding could select an old same-number intent in one tested case, whereas unique predecessor-epoch binding rejected the old record. With one new epoch-matching replica plus one old same-number replica, epoch binding continued and repaired the missing replica while generation-only binding could not disambiguate.
mechanism_revision: Bind each replicated prospective intent to a non-reused predecessor epoch identity, not merely a reusable slot or numeric generation. Recovery first requires one unique current-epoch intent and repairs its missing replica; successor self-certification remains a post-selection integrity check. Numeric generation is safe as the selection key only under an explicit no-reuse invariant.
neuroscience_transfer: Recurrence-sensitive reinstatement should use an episode/context tag to select the intended trace before evaluating content integrity. Reused ordinal position or familiarity with surviving content is not sufficient to identify the active episode.
scope_guard: Evidence is limited to eight symbolic serialized single-writer cases with immutable intent records, two intent replicas, one atomic current record, unique non-reused epoch identities, and successor self-certification. No claim for concurrent writers, non-atomic current updates, epoch identity reuse, double loss of current intent replicas, or journal garbage-collection races.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local persistence/readback only; no hosted compute used as part of the mechanism
mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: Unique predecessor-epoch binding prevented stale same-slot selection under the tested reuse cases while preserving one-copy repair and fail-closed conflict handling.
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: The current predecessor record is still assumed atomic and trustworthy; a partial or stale current record can make predecessor selection ambiguous even when intents are epoch-bound.

No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, scheduler, protected-primary, hosted-compute, paid, finite-credit, or manual-user execution semantics were used.
